contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ [--]TIVS[IVN] NOB C ; R/ [P]ROVIDEN TIAE CAESS

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus of Constantius II (323-361), Providentiae Caess issue of 324-330, Trier mint, Reece period 16, LRBC no. 18-19. Obverse description: Youthful bust laureate draped in imperial mantle and cuirassed left. Obverse inscription: [--]TIVS[IVN] NOB C. Reverse description: Camp gate with two towers. Reverse inscription: [P]ROVIDEN TIAE CAESS. In exergue: [-]T[-]. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin which has a soapy feel. Diameter: 18.9mm, Weight: 2.03gms, die axis: 6
